verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Fin publishes an llms.txt at fin.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing its content structure and canonical sources for LLMs, so an agent can be pointed at it. Beyond that, the agent-oriented docs surface is thin: markdown doc variants return 404, no OpenAPI spec was found at the candidate paths, and the llms.txt content is evidenced only by a truncated header. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth and completeness (e.g. llms-full.txt or linked docs coverage), markdown/agent-readable versions of the help docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://fin.ai/llms.txt # Fin — llms.txt
This file helps large language models (LLMs) understand the content structure, canonical sources
